mode.title: Mode
mode.description: profile = public profile with subscriber count, bio, link and related accounts. spotlight = each Spotlight video of an account with its view count. highlights = Stories/highlights with every snap media URL. lenses = AR lenses published by the account. related = walk Snapchat's own 'related accounts' graph out from your seeds. trending = the public Spotlight feed (no username needed). top-lenses = the Lens hub chart (no username needed). reference = probe which surfaces are live right now.
enumTitles: spotlight - Spotlight videos with view counts
highlights - Stories & highlights with snap media
lenses - AR lenses published by the account
related - discover accounts via Snapchat's graph
reference - which surfaces are live (probed live)

username.title: Username
username.description: A single Snapchat username. '@nasa', 'nasa' and 'https://www.snapchat.com/add/nasa' are all accepted.

usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: Multiple Snapchat usernames or profile URLs to process in one run. Used by the profile, spotlight, highlights, lenses and related modes.

relatedDepth.title: Related depth (related mode)
relatedDepth.description: How many levels to expand out from each seed. 0 = seeds only, 1 = seeds plus the accounts Snapchat lists as related, 2 = their related accounts too. Capped at 3 because each level multiplies the number of requests.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language for the text Snapchat renders (bio and titles are user-generated and stay as written). Snapchat otherwise follows the exit IP, so 'en-US' keeps output stable no matter where the run executes.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records for this run, across all usernames.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many usernames to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Snapchat served every recon request without a proxy and no anti-bot challenge was seen; use one only if your IP is rate-limited or you want a specific country's locale.
